$comment: Conformance cases for one entry of `capability.list` (`GET /api/v1/capabilities`), added by protocol 1.2 with issue #43. Validated against fenixspoon.core.discovery.CapabilitySummary. Each payload is a single summary, not the list, so a failure names the entry that broke. See environment.json for why the JS SDK does not read these.

valid.name: an adapter that accepts several geometry kinds
valid.$comment: No shipped adapter does yet, but `geometry_types` has always been a list and the summary must not narrow it to one.

valid.name: an adapter that declared neither physics nor availability
valid.$comment: The declaration attributes all have defaults so an adapter written before 1.2 keeps working. It reports `unspecified` rather than failing to be listed — a capability that cannot describe itself is still a capability a caller can submit to.

invalid.name: missing availability
invalid.reason: Whether this is the real solver or the development stand-in is the question `capability.list` exists to answer cheaply. `unspecified` is a permitted value; omitting the field is not.

invalid.name: geometry_types as a bare string
invalid.reason: A list of one is not the same shape as a string, and a caller that iterates would iterate the characters of 'domain2d'.

invalid.name: no name
invalid.reason: The name is what a caller passes to `capability.describe` and to `solver` on submit; a summary without one describes nothing reachable.
